### Description:
  Gets a list of users with access to the specified shared file. Also gets the file metadata, providing context and information about the shared file such as each user's role for accessing the file and the user who shared the file.
### Precondition:
  File sharing must be activated on the system. Must be assigned the `user_view` permission for the shared file.

  Returns the list of users with access to the shared file, along with metadata about the shared file.

  Sort string syntax `FIELD_NAME:ORDER`.

  ORDER can be `asc` or `desc`.
### Sorting options:
  | FIELD_NAME | Description |
  |------------|-------------|
  | id         | The member ID |
  | userId     | The user ID |
  | groupId    | The group ID |
  | roleId     | The role ID |

get.summary: Get email attachments sent by the current user
get.description:
### Description:
  Using an email ID, gets a list of files attached to messages in the current user's Inbox or Drafts folder, including file metadata.
### Preconditions:
  Messages must belong to the current user.
### Response:
  Returns the list of email attachments with associated metadata.
### Sorting:
  Sort string syntax `FIELD_NAME:ORDER`.

  ORDER can be `asc` or `desc`.
### Sorting options:
  | FIELD_NAME    | Description                              |
  |---------------|------------------------------------------|
  | id            | The mail ID                              |
  | subject       | The mail subject                         |
  | sent_date     | The date the mail was sent               |

### Description:

### Precondition:
  If the user is assigned the Restricted profile, the "Collaboration Allowed" setting must be turned on to get results.

### Sorting:
  Sorting can be applied using two query parameters: `orderBy` for the field name,
  and `orderType` for the sort order, which can be either `asc` or `desc`.
### Sorting field options:
  | FIELD_NAME | Description |
  |------------|-------------|
  | name       | The name of the file |
  | size       | The size of the file |
  | shared     | The datetime when the file was shared |

parameters.name: orderBy

Field to sort by. Default is `shared`.
Allowed values: `name`, `size`, `shared`, `sharedBy`, `modified`.

parameters.name: orderType
parameters.description: Sort direction. `asc` for ascending, `desc` for descending. Default is `desc`.

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Range offset.

parameters.name: with
parameters.description: Specifies additional fields to include in the response.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

get.description:
### Description:
  Searches for files, folders, or emails based on the provided query parameters.
### Precondition:
  The user must be authenticated.
### Response:
  Returns a list of matching files, folders, or emails.
### Sorting:
  Sorting can be applied using two query parameters: `orderBy` for the field name,
  and `orderType` for the sort order, which can be either `asc` or `desc`.
### Sorting options:
  | FIELD_NAME | Description |
  |------------|-------------|
  | score      | The search relevance score |
  | name       | The name of the folder or file |
  | created    | The creation datetime of the folder or file |
  | modified   | The last modified datetime of the folder or file |

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Range limit.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Range offset.

parameters.name: includeContent
parameters.description: Indicates whether it is a full-text search or a database search.

parameters.name: searchType
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of object types to search.
`f` – Files.
`d` – Folders.
`e` – Emails.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query string.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: Search within a specific folder ID.

parameters.name: created
parameters.description: Exact creation date.

parameters.name: created:gt
parameters.description: Created after the specified date.

parameters.name: created:gte
parameters.description: Created on or after the specified date.

parameters.name: created:lt
parameters.description: Created before the specified date.

parameters.name: created:lte
parameters.description: Created on or before the specified date.

parameters.name: modified
parameters.description: Exact modified date.

parameters.name: modified:gt
parameters.description: Modified after the specified date.

parameters.name: modified:gte
parameters.description: Modified on or after the specified date.

parameters.name: modified:lt
parameters.description: Modified before the specified date.

parameters.name: modified:lte
parameters.description: Modified on or before the specified date.

parameters.name: fileSize
parameters.description: Exact file size in bytes.

parameters.name: fileSize:gt
parameters.description: File size greater than the specified value.

parameters.name: fileSize:gte
parameters.description: File size greater than or equal to the specified value.

parameters.name: fileSize:lt
parameters.description: File size less than the specified value.

parameters.name: fileSize:lte
parameters.description: File size less than or equal to the specified value.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User email of the folder creator.

parameters.name: fileType
parameters.description: List of comma-separated file types to filter search results.

parameters.name: flsOnly
parameters.description: If true, only includes files shared with the user.

parameters.name: sharedMailboxId
parameters.description: Shared mailbox ID.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description:
Field to sort results by.
Allowed values: `score`, `name`, `created`, `modified`.

parameters.name: orderType
parameters.description:
Sort direction for the results.
`asc` – Ascending order.
`desc` – Descending order.

parameters.name: nameOnly
parameters.description: If true, searches only for file/folder names.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Email subject filter.

parameters.name: senderId
parameters.description: Sender ID.

parameters.name: recipientId
parameters.description: Recipient ID.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: File name filter.

parameters.name: folderName
parameters.description: Folder name filter.

parameters.name: fileContent
parameters.description: Search within file content.

parameters.name: spellCheck
parameters.description: If true, provides spelling suggestions for the search query.

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description:
Filter email search results by mailbox folder.
`inbox` – Search in the inbox.
`sent` – Search in sent items.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Search within a specific folder path.

parameters.name: tracking_id
parameters.description: Filter files by their tracking ID (UUID).

parameters.name: extensions
parameters.description: Comma-separated file extensions to filter (e.g., "pdf,form" or ".pdf,.form").

200.description: Search completed successfully.

post.description:
### Description:
  Uploads a single chunk of a file to the server using the upload link obtained from an initiate-upload call. The file is reconstructed server-side once all chunks are received.
### Precondition:
  * The caller must hold a valid upload link.
  * The client must split the file into chunks before uploading.
  * Chunks must be uploaded sequentially, starting from index 1.
### Response:
  Returns the updated upload session after each intermediate chunk, and the completed file record after the final chunk.

files.description: List of file UUIDs to attach to the email.

acl.description:
Defines the access control level for the email.
`verify_recipient` – Accessible only to specified recipients.
`no_auth` – Public access, no authentication required.
`otp` – Accessible to recipients; allows one-time passcode (OTP) via SMS for authentication.
`internal` – Accessible to recipients and users within the organization.
`anyone_auth` – Accessible to recipients and any authenticated user.
`email_otp` – Accessible to recipients; allows one-time passcode (OTP) via email for authentication.

expire.description: The expiration date of the email.

draft.description: Indicates if the email is being saved as a draft.

preview.description: Indicates if the email is a view-only version.

watermark.description: Text watermark applied to the email attachments (only applicable when `preview` is enabled).

secureBody.description: If true, the email body is hidden from the notification email and is only visible to authenticated recipients when they open the secure link.

selfCopy.description: Indicates if the sender should receive a copy of the email.

includeFingerprint.description: If true, a cryptographic hash (fingerprint) of each attached file is included in the notification email, allowing recipients to verify file integrity.

parentEmailId.description: The parent email ID used for email threading. Applicable only for `forward` or `reply` types.

isSelfReturnReceipt.description: (Deprecated) Send download notification to the sender. Use 'returnReceipts' instead.

returnReceipts.description: List of recipients who should receive a download notification.

type.description:
The type of email. Defaults to `original`.
`original` – A new email.
`forward` – Forwarding an existing email to new recipients.
`reply` – A reply to an existing email.
`resend` – Resending a previously sent email.

uploading.description: Indicates whether file upload is still in progress. Prevents sending if set to `true`.

body.description: The body content of the email.

subject.description: The subject of the email (maximum length: 998 characters).

webFormId.description: The web form ID associated with the email.

webFormFields.description: Custom web form fields associated with the email.

notifyExpired.description: Indicates whether to send a notification email to the sender when the email expires.

sharedMailboxId.description: UUID of the shared mailbox to send from. When set, the email is sent on behalf of the shared mailbox rather than the individual user.

displayName.description: Display name of the SCIM user.

userType.description: User type based on the assigned profile name.

active.description: Indicates whether the user account is active.

emails.description: List of email addresses for the user.

phoneNumbers.description: List of phone numbers for the user.

photos.description: List of photo URLs for the user.

roles.description: List of roles assigned to the user.

schemas.description: List of SCIM schema URIs applicable to this response.

totalResults.description: Total number of matching SCIM users.

itemsPerPage.description: Number of users returned per page.

startIndex.description: 1-based index of the first result in the current page.

remoteWipe.description: If true, triggers a remote wipe of the user data from all registered devices.

deleteUnsharedData.description: If true, permanently deletes data that is not shared with other users.

retainData.description: If true, retains the user data after deletion.

retainPermissionToSharedData.description: If true, the specified `retainToUser` will retain access to shared data.

retainToUser.description: UUID of the user who will receive ownership of the deleted user data.

schemas.description: List of SCIM schema URNs applicable to this resource. Must include `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User`.

displayName.description: The user's display name. Must not contain `<` or `>` characters.

userType.description: The user's type identifier (alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens only).

phoneNumbers.description: List of phone numbers associated with the user.

roles.description: List of roles assigned to the user. At most one role may be specified.

active.description: If true, activates the user account; if false, deactivates it.

userTypeDemotionOptions.description: Data retention options to apply when the user type is demoted.

ok.description: Overall health status indicator. `1` means all components are healthy; `0` means one or more components are unhealthy.

name.description: Name of the subfolder to create under the form owner's folder for this submission.

submitter.description: Email address of the user submitting the form. Pass `null` to create an anonymous submission.

created.description: Date and time when the upload link was created.

parentId.description: Unique identifier of the parent folder where files will be uploaded.

totalSize.description: Total size of the upload in bytes.

uri.description: Relative URI of the upload link.

uploadUrl.description: The complete URL for the upload link.

filename.description: The filename of the EPGDB backup file being uploaded.

userId.description: The UUID of the user to convert into a shared mailbox.

memberIds.description: List of member UUIDs to add to the shared mailbox.  (Recommended request size <= 100)

remoteWipe.description: If true, remotely wipes all devices associated with the user being converted.

deleteUnsharedData.description: If true, deletes any data that is not shared with other users after conversion.

retainData.description: If true, retains the user's data and transfers it to the specified `retainToUser`.

retainToUser.description: The UUID of the user who will receive the retained data.

retainPermissionToSharedData.description: If true, the `retainToUser` will also receive permissions to the shared data.

retainToAdvancedFormUser.description: The UUID of an alternate user for advanced data retention scenarios.

memberIds.description: List of member ids  (Recommended request size <= 100)

type.description: Type of card action.

url.description: URL the card action links to.

id.description: Unique identifier of the card host.

name.description: Display name of the card host.

message.description: Main message text of the card.

description.description: Descriptive text providing additional detail for the card.

actions.description: List of actions available on the card.

type.description: Type of the card.

host.description: Host information associated with the card.

data.description: Additional structured data associated with the card.

action.description:
The action to perform on the card.
`retry` – Retry the failed operation.
`delete` – Delete the card or related records.

type.description:
The type of card to perform the action on.
`content_encryption` – Content encryption card.
`email_json_migration` – Email JSON migration card.
`system_security_scanning` – System security scanning card.
`events_table_monitor` – Events table monitor card.
`appadmin_db` – Application admin database card.
`sysadmin_db` – System admin database card.
`sysadmin_hosts` – System admin hosts card.
`epg_warnings` – EPG warnings card.
`safe_edit_server_health` – Safe edit server health card.

hostId.description: The unique identifier of the host associated with the card.

storageType.description:
The storage type for the files to process.
`user_files` – User file storage.
`replication_files` – Replication file storage.

volume.description: The storage volume containing the files to process.

fileId.description: List of file IDs to retry content encryption for.

emailId.description: List of email IDs to retry migrating to JSON format.

ids.description: List of file object IDs (UUID) to be updated.

expire.description: New expiration date for the selected files.

ids.description: List of folder object IDs to be updated.

expire.description: Expiration date for the folder.

applyTo.description:
Defines the scope of the expiration update.
`folders` – Apply expiration to folders only.
`files` – Apply expiration to files only.
`folders_and_files` – Apply expiration to both folders and files.

quota.description: Storage quota for the folder in bytes. Must be one of the permitted sizes: 1 GB (1,073,741,824), 2 GB (2,147,483,648), 5 GB (5,368,709,120), 10 GB (10,737,418,240), 50 GB (53,687,091,200), or -1 for unlimited.

applyToNestedFiles.description: If set to `true`, expiration will also apply to files in child folders.

service_status.description:
The MariaDB service status.
`active` – Service is running.
`inactive` – Service is not running.

active_connection_count.description: Real-time number of active database connections.

wsrep_cluster_status.description: Galera cluster status indicating whether this node is the primary component.

wsrep_cluster_size.description: Number of healthy nodes in the Galera cluster.

wsrep_local_state_comment.description: Galera local state indicating readiness to accept read/write requests. `Synced` is the healthy value.

memory_usage_mb.description: Real-time RSS memory usage of the MariaDB service in MB.

cpu_usage_percentage.description: Real-time CPU usage percentage by the MariaDB service.

db_partition_free_mb.description: Free space available on the database partition in MB.

db_partition_used_mb.description: Used space on the database partition in MB.

status.description:
The Nginx service status.
`active` – Service is running.
`inactive` – Service is not running.

active_connections.description: Real-time number of active connections to the local Nginx instance.

reading.description: Real-time number of connections currently reading the request header.

writing.description: Real-time number of connections currently writing a response.

connection_efficiency.description: Ratio of handled connections to accepted connections.

avg_requests_per_connection.description: Ratio of total requests to handled connections.

service_status.description:
The job queue service status.
`active` – Service is running.
`inactive` – Service is not running.

memory_usage_mb.description: RSS memory usage of the job queue service in MB.

queue_jq_acfs_conv.description: Number of jobs in the file preview queue.

queue_jq_scan.description: Number of jobs in the antivirus scan queue.

queue_jq_acfs.description: Number of fingerprint jobs queued to be executed on the ACFS node.

current_queued_job_count.description: Real-time number of jobs currently waiting in the queue.

current_working_job_count.description: Real-time number of jobs currently being processed.

current_failed_job_count.description: Real-time number of jobs that have failed.

memory_usage_mb.description: Total RSS memory usage by SFTP processes in MB.

total_memory_usage_mb.description: Total system RSS memory usage in MB.

total_swap_usage_mb.description: Total system swap usage in MB.

total_cpu_usage_percent.description: Total system CPU usage as a percentage.

system_load_average_1min.description: System load average over the last 1 minute.

system_load_average_5min.description: System load average over the last 5 minutes.

system_load_average_15min.description: System load average over the last 15 minutes.

kw_database.description: Database health metrics. Present when `metric_name` is `kwDatabase` or `allMetrics`.

web_requests.description: Web request health metrics. Present when `metric_name` is `webRequests` or `allMetrics`.

jobqueued.description: Job queue health metrics. Present when `metric_name` is `jobqueued` or `allMetrics`.

sftp.description: SFTP health metrics. Present when `metric_name` is `sftp` or `allMetrics`.

system_resources.description: System resource metrics. Present when `metric_name` is `systemResources` or `allMetrics`.

failed_ids.description: List of user emails that failed during import.

errors.description: List of error details encountered during import.

ids.description: List of user UUIDs whose TOTP secrets should be deleted. Must contain between 1 and 100 IDs.

id.description: Unique identifier of the SSH public key.

name.description: Display name for the SSH public key.

active.description: Indicates whether the SSH public key is active and can be used for authentication.

adminActive.description: Indicates whether an administrator has enabled this SSH public key.

deleted.description: Indicates whether the SSH public key has been deleted.
